title: Fix HAProxy Socket Access for Weight Changes

title: Sprint 2: HAProxy Integration Validation
description: Confirm HAProxy admin socket connectivity. Test weight adjuster connection and execute at least one weight change.
close_reason: PARTIAL: HAProxy stats CSV accessible via HTTP (/health check OK). Weight READING works via HTTP fallback (80/20 detected). Weight SETTING requires Unix socket access - HAProxy admin HTTP only supports state changes, not weight changes. RECOMMENDATION: Use dedicated socket volume or use HAProxy Data Plane API for full integration. Current code gracefully degrades to read-only mode.
